papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.summary: Introduces a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method that freezes the pretrained model and injects small trainable low-rank matrices into each layer, making it cheap to adapt huge language models to new tasks.

papers.title: The Rise and Potential of Large Language Model Based Agents: A Survey
papers.summary: A comprehensive survey of how LLMs are used as the 'brain' of autonomous agents, covering their architecture (perception, memory, planning, action), capabilities, applications, and evaluation.
